purpose: Define the public certification registry as an index of certification status and package hashes, not as the owner of certified package semantics.

topics.name: Certification Registry
topics.purpose: Define the public certification registry as an index of certification status and package hashes, not as the owner of certified package semantics.

semantics.ownership_rule: Registry does not own certified package semantics.
semantics.status_rule: Registry entry explicitly identifies certification status and package hash.
semantics.cache_rule: Clients may cache verified registry evidence according to explicit policy.
semantics.revocation_rule: Revoked/invalid certification status is explicit and machine-readable.
semantics.format_rule: CSV/hash files are serialization/publication formats only.

invariants.rule: Packaging, hashing, certification and repository distribution preserve canonical semantics but do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: revoked certification remains represented as valid
registry lookup result grants runtime authority
CSV/file format treated as semantic authority
package hash absent from certification registry entry

prose.summary: Define the public certification registry as an index of certification status and package hashes, not as the owner of certified package semantics.
